text:
maya: Heads up — dashboards showing aggregate churn for 2026-03-16..2026-03-18 look stale, digging now. noticed missing /partition_date=2026-03-17/* in telemetry-s3 (eu-prod).

sam: thanks, maya. do you have the exact prefix? is this a full miss or sparse files? :thinking_face:

maya: full miss for two metrics shards (shard-3, shard-7). prefix: s3://redwood-telemetry/eu/prod/ingest/shard-3/partition_date=2026-03-17/

eli: hmm — last successful writer logs show a lambda timeout around 2026-03-17T02:42Z and the parquet writer rolled an empty file. log snippet: ```ERROR Timeout writing parquet for partition=2026-03-17 shard=3 duration_ms=120500```

jen: that matches the dashboard spike where counts dropped to 0. can we rehydrate just those missing partitions? we should avoid a full recompute.

maya: plan proposal: 1) identify missing partitions across shards (list) 2) run targeted replayer for those partitions with reduced concurrency 3) push annotation to dashboard showing corrected window and ETA

sam: +1. we should also create a temporary priority lane so replayer doesn't trample normal jobs. quota bump required for short window. how many partitions total?

maya: total 4 partitions (shard-3:2026-03-17, shard-7:2026-03-17, shard-3:2026-03-18 partial, shard-2:2026-03-17 partial). will run discovery script and post exact list in 5m.

opsbot: alert posted: "ingest-lag-detection: partition-missing: s3://redwood-telemetry/eu/prod/partition_date=2026-03-17" :warning:

eli: note — replayer supports `--partition-only` and `--max-concurrency`. suggested command: ```./replayer run --dataset telemetry --partition 2026-03-17 --shard 3 --partition-only --max-concurrency 8 --dry-run```

jen: also add `--preserve-order` flag for these metrics otherwise downstream joins might misalign.

sam: ops question: do we want to use burst quota (dedicated reserved) or temporary project quota? recommend temp project quota + SLA exception. Ops, can you approve 2x burst for 30m? @opsbot

opsbot: requested quota bump ticket created (#Q-4871). approvers: platform-oncall, infra-sre.

maya: discovery done — missing partitions list: [shard-3:2026-03-17, shard-7:2026-03-17, shard-3:2026-03-18:part-0001-empty, shard-2:2026-03-17:part-0002-corrupt]. putting them into a targeted job.

eli: running dry-run now to validate records found and output size. paste of dry-run output: ```found_rows=124812 expected_rows=124812 output_estimate=45MB```

jen: looks good. if dry-run matches, schedule real run with `--max-concurrency 16` for speed but cap token cost via quota lane. also set `--result-checksum` to verify.

sam: I'll open a temporary route in the scheduler: priority=high, window=30m, concurrency=16, quota-bump=Q-4871. once replayer succeeds, we run the aggregation recompute step for only affected aggregates.

maya: quick note for dashboards: adding annotation and forcing a partial refresh for affected tiles. dashboard query will hit recompute cache; will invalidate keys after aggregation succeed. ETA ~45m after approval.

eli: running real job now (starting at 2798765490). monitoring logs here: https://logs.redwood.internal/replayer/2798765490. will post success or error.

(5m) eli: job finished: exit=0 rows_written=124812 files=3 duration_s=420 checksum=ab12f3.

maya: aggregation recompute started for the 4 partitions (job 2798765510). note: using incremental windowing so only touched keys are recalculated.

jen: dashboard annotation pushed, showing "stale window corrected — recompute in progress". users will see note on chart. :loudspeaker:

sam: once recompute succeeds, we should run a short smoke test (token-level counts + top-10 customers) and then close Q-4871. assign smoke to jen.

jen: doing smoke now. verifying top customers: OK, counts within expected ±0.2%. no obvious regressions.

opsbot: ticket Q-4871 auto-updated: quota bump closed.

maya: closing loop — root cause: transient lambda writer timeout causing empty parquet; filing infra bug to soft-fail rather than write empty files. filing IB-9012.

eli: tagging follow-up: add per-partition health metric to telemetry exporter so we can alert earlier.

sam: great job folks. can we add a short runbook note to the recompute page: "when missing partitions <10, prefer targeted replayer with priority lane + dry-run verification" — jen please add?

jen: will PR runbook now and link to IB-9012 and Q-4871. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/72

maya: done, thanks all :tada: 

sam: leaving this thread but will check postmortem tomorrow. :eyes:
